title: Dawn on Santa Anna
synopsis: A bookseller and his son live above the shop. The city is still dark.

title: The lower Rambla
synopsis: Father and son walk toward the port under a dawn of ashen skies.

title: A hidden library
synopsis: Behind an unremarkable door, a labyrinth of unwanted books. The boy chooses one volume.

title: Empty catalogues
synopsis: The name on the spine is missing from every catalogue in the shop.

title: Barceló at Els Quatre Gats
synopsis: They take the book to a collector who already wants to buy it.

title: Clara at the Ateneo
synopsis: In the library, the collector sits beside a woman in white. The book, he says, is now unique.

title: A castle on the hill
synopsis: Clara tells how she first met the novelist’s work, and how her father died in a fortress after the war began.

title: A name from the war
synopsis: Someone has been buying the novels in order to burn them. A policeman’s name is attached to an old killing.

title: Plaça Reial
synopsis: Daniel has come from the collector’s house, carrying a wartime story home.

title: A remembered pen
synopsis: A fountain pen in a window he could not have. The memory returns while he thinks about writing.

title: A watching street
synopsis: Near home, Daniel thinks he is being watched. By morning he will try to believe he imagined it.

title: Bernarda at the door
synopsis: The maid lets him in. Clara is at the piano. A teacher named Neri has been hired to fix her playing.

title: Afternoons with Clara
synopsis: He reads aloud. They walk, and he describes the street. A stranger once asked Clara about the two of them. His face felt like leather.

title: An empty table
synopsis: Mr. Sempere cooks. Clara has a lesson. Barceló is out of town. Only Bernarda comes.

title: A man at the port
synopsis: Daniel walks to the water. A limping stranger knows his name, smells of burned paper, and collects Carax in order to burn him.

title: Back through the storm
synopsis: He runs for the book on Clara’s shelf. A man in the doorway asks to sleep in the lobby. A voice comes from her room.

title: Wine in the doorway
synopsis: Clara was not alone. In the street the man from the lobby offers wine and a long story. He says his name is Fermín Romero de Torres.

title: A name for the burner
synopsis: Isaac has heard the name Laín Coubert. A publisher’s warehouse burned. His daughter Nuria saved copies. Carax’s father keeps a hat shop.

title: The fountain pen
synopsis: Home after midnight. His father is still dressed. The pen from the window is on the table.

title: A suit and a job
synopsis: Daniel brings Fermín in. There are scars. Mr. Sempere offers work. Fermín weeps at the table.

title: A room without a register
synopsis: Doña Encarna keeps him off the books. One night he will not come out of the room. Dr. Baró puts him to sleep.

title: Someone in the aisle
synopsis: Fermín is buying sweets. Daniel sees the burned man a few seats away. Then the man is gone.

title: Tomás and his sister
synopsis: Daniel has time for Tomás again. Bea looks like a film still. Her fiancé talks about Spain’s superiority. Daniel does not like her.

title: A photograph in the shop
synopsis: Bernarda comes for a book. Fermín walks her out. Later the shop is not empty. A half-burned picture shows a couple and a hat-shop window.

title: Bea in the office
synopsis: The professor is talking to a student. She turns around. It is Bea. She will marry and go to El Ferrol. Daniel asks for Friday.

title: The shut hat shop
synopsis: Doña Aurora keeps the building. She says Carax left for Paris to escape the army, and that Fortuny later said the boy had died.

title: A locked room
synopsis: The key is in a music box. The room is scratched with crosses. A picture is signed Penélope, who loves you. Daniel pockets an old letter.

title: The inspector at the counter
synopsis: A man who hates books identifies himself as Chief Inspector Fumero. He is less interested in the watchmaker than in Fermín.

title: A gate on Tibidabo
synopsis: The letter’s return address is number 32. Hedges, a dead fountain, broken statues. A caretaker says the Aldayas had a son. Not a daughter.

title: News in the street
synopsis: Don Anacleto brings the news. Don Federico was taken to a cell and sent home broken. Fumero’s name is on the night.

title: Nuria in the courtyard
synopsis: The card says Nuria Monfort and Miquel Moliner. She is reading downstairs. She does not believe Daniel was sent by her father.

title: An apartment adrift
synopsis: She knew Carax in Paris. She does not know Penélope. She says he was buried in 1936. She thinks the burner may be Jorge.

title: Friday in the cloister
synopsis: Bea is waiting. She says she came to prove him wrong. They walk to a café, and he tells her everything he has found.

title: Bea at the hidden door
synopsis: Isaac lets her in. Daniel shows her where the novel is hidden. She chooses a book that feels as if it had been waiting.

title: The lawyer who is not
synopsis: Requejo does not exist. Nuria collects that box. Fermín wants the old school: San Gabriel.

title: Tomás at the counter
synopsis: Bea came home late. Their father shouted. Daniel tells Tomás it was him. Tomás asks him not to hurt her.

title: What they think they know
synopsis: They put the school, the letter, and the burner on the table. Daniel cannot keep his breakfast down.

title: San Gabriel
synopsis: A worn Gothic school outside the old city. The first man they meet is Father Fernando Ramos, who was in the same class.

title: A girl on the stairs
synopsis: Aldaya took a liking to the hatter’s boy. Jorge showed him the house. A girl on the stairs stopped him where he stood.

title: A hospice they have not walked to
synopsis: The woodcarver in that class is Fumero. Fernando says the governess Jacinta is at Santa Lucía. No one saw Penélope after 1919.

title: A card with a number
synopsis: Bea has told her father she is at mass. The card in Daniel’s hand is the Aldaya address.

title: The Angel of Mist
synopsis: The gate is open. Bea is in the hall. Her father’s firm holds the house. They light a fire.

title: A letter in the grate
synopsis: Bea tells the older story of the house. She asks if she should send the letter to Pablo. It burns.

title: The hospice road
synopsis: Miquel is not in prison. The hospice is an old building on the edge of the city, watched by nuns.

title: Corridors that forget
synopsis: They walk the wards asking for Jacinta. Most of the beds have no answer.

title: Jacinta speaks
synopsis: She tells the notes, the party, the train. Penélope never came. Mr. Aldaya had Jacinta put away.

title: Stopped on the road
synopsis: Fumero wants to know why they were inside. Fermín will not bow. Daniel is made to watch.

title: Fermín at Plaça Reial
synopsis: Bernarda holds him. Barceló calls it a minor accident. Clara asks to be forgiven.

title: Barceló takes the case
synopsis: He wants Nuria told that the lies are known. At dawn Daniel’s father is still at the table.

title: A door of angels
synopsis: Heat in the cellar. A crypt. A coffin with her name. A burned voice says to get out.

title: Seven days
synopsis: A dead line. A dark window. Daniel walks the block and does not go in.

title: The cloister without her
synopsis: The students have not seen Bea. Her father answers the telephone.

title: What Fumero did
synopsis: They lose the policeman with a lie. Fermín tells the war, the cell, and the names he gave.

title: Back to Nuria’s stairs
moodLabel: a walk that is not a walk
synopsis: A radio on the landing talks about the devil. Daniel goes up.

title: She knows he knows
synopsis: He names the lawyer who does not exist. She is afraid Fumero has been walked to her door.

title: A cassock in the street
synopsis: Fermín is dressed as a priest and does not come up.

title: What the morgue said
synopsis: A letter from the army is on the table. The man who received a body in 1936 does not confirm Nuria’s dates.

title: The shop smashed
synopsis: Fumero breaks the furniture. Then Don Anacleto brings tomorrow’s paper.

title: Rain and a window
synopsis: Daniel and his father quarrel. Tomás stands at the glass and does not wave.

title: A parcel not ordered
synopsis: Don Federico has a bag ready. Inside: the missal from the cassock, and a note that Fermín is alive.

title: A funeral without her father
synopsis: Neighbours come. Isaac does not. Palacios says her last words were for someone else.

title: The envelope
synopsis: Isaac has already read it. He does not know his daughter any more. Daniel takes the pages home.

title: Paris, in her hand
synopsis: She met him as someone who still published books that did not sell.

title: A name he would not drop
synopsis: He would sleep beside her and still belong to a girl in Barcelona.

title: What the house did
synopsis: After the failed elopement the girl was kept in the house. She did not leave it alive.

title: What Sophie said
moodLabel: a thing not to tell him
synopsis: Sophie told Miquel why Carax and Penélope could never have been only lovers.

title: A passport that was not his
synopsis: Miquel found him at the old house and took the papers so the shots would find the wrong man.

title: The warehouse
synopsis: He burned the stock. He walked out without a face that could be shown in a shop.

title: The boy who would not sell
synopsis: The burned man kept an eye on the bookshop because the boy had refused him once.

title: Tomás at the door
synopsis: Bea is gone. Tomás will not help. He uses his fists instead.

title: Back to the Angel
synopsis: He looks for her in the only empty house they share.

title: Three in the house
synopsis: She is already there. So is the man from the crypt. Then the garden fills.

title: The fountain angel
synopsis: The statue that lay in the basin is no longer only stone. A shot. Then the siren.

title: A white room
synopsis: The papers invent a cleaner death for Fumero. A pen goes from the bedside and does not come back.

title: A wedding anyway
synopsis: Father Fernando will marry them. Mr. Aguilar still does not like the groom.

title: Jacinta is gone
synopsis: They keep an old promise to the man in the ward. Jacinta died after a last visitor.

title: Dawn with a son
synopsis: Years on. A bookseller takes a small boy through a sleeping city to a door that is still there.
